name: Continue fictional character roleplay narratives
description: Users asked the AI to engage in or continue fan-fiction roleplay scenarios, often featuring characters from the Doki Doki Literature Club or creating original characters in school and game settings. The interactions varied from lighthearted clubroom activities and creative dialogues to more intense or specific narrative scenarios involving relationships, physical situations, and dark plot elements.
